a warm olive complexion, late 20s goddess, curved bust physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — an extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person; both her bust and her hips are simultaneously, dramatically enormous, a colossal heavy bust resting full and wide, and enormous round hips flaring just as dramatically wide below, but unlike a sharply cinched hourglass, her waistline stays soft and only gently defined between them, a full, natural figure rather than a snatched one; gigantic soft thighs pressed together, very thick soft arms, a full round face; her head looks small on top of her massive body; her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other, shaggy layered rose pink hair — wearing a skin-tight micro yukata-style wrap dress of ultra-thin matte indigo modal jersey with a white hydrangea print and short wide sleeves ending above her elbows, the left front crossing over the right in a deep plunging V that opens down to her belly button over her bust with a front zipper hidden along the crossing, a slim obi sash about four fingers wide in pale coral tied low at her hip bones in a flat bow at the front, a plain ultra-high slit cut up the right side of the skirt from the hem to her hip bone, the hem ending just below her hip bones, a micro length hardly longer than a belt, her arms and legs bare, the modal jersey shrink-wrapped onto her body like a second skin, fully opaque, her face and hands bare. The garments cling like a second skin and show real material behaviour: the thin modal jersey molded so closely that it shows the soft relief of her collarbones, her hip bones and the gentle rise of her bust and hips, the white hydrangea print and the coral obi bow crisp against the deep indigo, fine stretch lines and a soft sheen. ONE woman only. Full-length wide shot from a moderate distance with the camera at waist height, the whole figure from the soles of the boots to the top of her head completely visible, with the door, railing or steps beside her at normal human scale so the extreme heel height reads at a glance, the towering heels clearly separating the boot soles from the floor. This is one single photograph taken with one camera at one moment, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/5.6, realistic photographic grain, a real photograph.
